$comment: The agent presets presets.mjs adds to a machine's Paseo (daemon.agentProfiles
in ~/.paseo/config.json). Each id is stable, so a second run finds its own
preset; a preset with the same name counts as present too. Edit a model here
when it ages: an unknown model shows in Paseo as unavailable, not a crash.
